comment: Reviewed npm advisories we accept, each with a reason and a review-by date (YYYY-MM-DD); an expired one fails the gate again.

exceptions.reason: picomatch ReDoS (CVE-2026-112366) on single-branch repeated extglobs; no patched release exists (npm's newest is 4.0.7, the affected range is <= 4.0.7, the upstream fix is an open pull request). Reached only through vite, svelte-check, fdir and tinyglobby, which are build and dev-server tooling fed our own globs; checked 2026-11-17: after `npm run build`, `grep -rl picomatch build` finds no file, so the shipped UI has none. Removal: delete this entry when picomatch above 4.0.7 ships and the lockfile takes it (the unused-exception notice then names it).
